steps.title: Define Project Properties and Metadata
steps.description: Establish package details, application name 'Luxe Light', and basic build environment parameters inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure System Gradle Build Settings
steps.description: Set up app/build.gradle with compile/target SDK version 34, min SDK 21, and establish system namespaces without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Declare Application Manifest & Hardware Features
steps.description: Set up AndroidManifest.xml with appropriate system namespace, camera permission declarations, and material dark configuration.

steps.title: Establish Theme Palette Values
steps.description: Formulate custom application colors in colors.xml, establishing premium dark, golden accent, blue highlight, and neutral tones.

steps.title: Create User Interface Copy Resources
steps.description: Draft standard label strings in strings.xml for the Luxe Light control dashboard, screen light settings, and party disco panel.

steps.title: Design Rounded Inactive Power Button Drawable
steps.description: Draft custom XML vector-shape drawable 'btn_round_off' to create the elegant dim state of the primary power button.

steps.title: Design Glowing Active Power Button Drawable
steps.description: Draft custom XML vector-shape drawable 'btn_round_on' representing the radiant active torch state.

steps.title: Construct Dark Panel Cards
steps.description: Establish a sleek curved layout surface using card_background.xml drawable configuration.

steps.title: Build UI Control Layout Configuration
steps.description: Assemble activity_main.xml layout structure. Implement bottom tab navigation structure, torch interface, screen brightness options, and party system panel.

steps.title: Code Flashlight & Screen Light Functionality
steps.description: Program MainActivity.java using the Camera2 API for flash operations. Implement multi-tab switching, adjustable strobe speeds, SOS sequencing, screen dimming, and synced disco loop.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source & Android Integration
steps.description: Inspect and sanitize source code to ensure strict anonymous inner class utilization and correct layout integrations.

steps.title: Building Luxe Light
steps.description: Execute local Gradle build framework using 'gradle assembleDebug' script to output the finished program file.
